variants.prompt: This confident beauty is captured in the neon-lit, smoky haze of a downtown nightclub, her emerald eyes glinting in the harsh light as she tilts her head back, exposing the long, slender column of her throat, her black leather jacket and ripped band tee a stark contrast to the pulsating colors of the dance floor, the camera's shallow focus blurring the revelry into a vibrant, abstract background.
